# ctyun_ipv6_bandwidth_association (Resource)
-> 管理共享带宽和弹性IP的绑定关系



## Example

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    ctyun = {
      source = "ctyun-it/ctyun"
    }
  }
}

provider "ctyun" {
  env = "prod"
}

resource "ctyun_ipv6_bandwidth_association" "test" {
  ipv6_bandwidth_id = "ipv6-bandwidth-3"
  ipv6 = 3
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ipv6` (String) IPv6 地址
- `ipv6_bandwidth_id` (String) IPv6带宽id

### Optional

- `region_id` (String) 资源池ID，如果不填则默认使用provider ctyun中的region_id或环境变量中的CTYUN_REGION_ID

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) id
